| Greek | `l` | `i` | avoided on purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| πευκεδανοῖο (πτολέμοιο … πευκεδανοῖο, 10.8; meaning and origin not known) | "sharp" | "sharp" (+ note: meaning not known) | "bitter", "piercing", "pine-sharp" (each decides the sense); keeps the ἐχεπευκές "sharp" of 1.51, which it may be related to |
| στόμα πολέμοιο (10.8) | "the great mouth of … war" | "the great mouth of … war" | "jaws", "edge", "the first line"; στόμα is "mouth" |
| πυκίν’ … ἀνεστενάχιζ’ … νειόθεν ἐκ κραδίης (10.9–10) | "so thickly … groaned up … from the depths, out of his heart" | "heaved groan after groan … from the depths of his heart" | "sighed deeply", "groaned repeatedly"; ἀναστενάχω "groan up", πυκινά "thickly", κραδίη "heart" |
| φρήν · φρένες (10.4, 10.10; singular φρήν, 10.45–46, is "mind" in both layers, as at 9.244) | "wits" | "mind" (10.4) · "wits" (10.10) | "heart" (reserved for κραδίη, ἦτορ, κῆρ), "thoughts"; `l` keeps "wits" (the Odyssey's φρένες "wits"), and `i` says "mind" where "pondered many things in his wits" would not read |
| ἐνοπή (αὐλῶν συρίγγων τ’ ἐνοπήν, 10.13; of instruments) | "the sound" | "the sound" | "voice", "shouting" (kept for ἐνοπή of men, 3.2), "music" |
| αὐλός · σῦριγξ (10.13) | "pipes" · "panpipes" | "pipes" · "panpipes" | "flutes", "reed-pipes", "pan-pipes"; σῦριγξ is the pipe of bound reeds (note says so) |
| προθελύμνους (10.15; built on θέλυμνα "foundations") | "root and all" | "root and all" | "by the roots", "tearing out", "violently"; keeps the image of the root |
| ὑψόθ’ ἐόντι Διί (10.16) | "to Zeus being on high" | "to Zeus on high" | "for Zeus", "in appeal to Zeus", "as an offering" (each decides what the dative means) |
| ἀλεξίκακος (10.20) | "evil-warding" | "that would ward off evil" | "averting", "protecting", "a defence"; ἀλέξω "ward off" + κακόν "evil" |
| δαφοινός (10.23, δαφοινὸν … δέρμα λέοντος; δα- intensive + φοινός "red") | "deep-red" | "deep-red" | "blood-red", "crimson" (kept for φοινικόεις), "tawny" (kept for αἴθων) |
| αἴθων (10.24, of a lion; the table has αἴθων σίδηρος "fire-bright iron") | "tawny" | "tawny" | "fire-bright" (the rendering for iron, which cannot be tawny), "blazing", "ruddy"; the word is "burning", and of an animal it is the colour |
| ποδηνεκές (10.24) | "reaching to the feet" | "reaching to his feet" | "foot-length", "falling to the heels" |
| ὣς δ’ αὔτως … ἔχε τρόμος (10.25) | "So in the same way a trembling held …" | "In the same way a trembling took hold of …" | "likewise", "just so" (kept for αὔτως alone); follows the table's ὣς δ’ αὔτως "So in the same way" and τοὺς δ’ ἄρ’ ὑπὸ τρόμος εἷλεν "A trembling took hold of them" |
| ὑγρήν (πουλὺν ἐφ’ ὑγρήν, 10.27; noun unsaid) | "over the broad wet" | "over the wide sea" | "over the watery way" (κέλευθα is "ways"), "the salt water"; the noun is left out in `l`, as in the Greek |
| παρδαλέη · ποικίλη (10.29–30, of a skin) | "leopard-skin" · "dappled" | "leopard-skin" · "dappled" | "panther-skin", "spotted"; ποικίλος "dappled" of a skin (kept apart from "inlaid" for worked metal and wood, and "intricate" for weaving) |
| στεφάνη (10.30; "that which goes round the head") | "circlet" | "helmet" (+ note: whether the whole helmet or its rim is not certain) | "crown", "rim", "headpiece"; the `l` keeps the literal "circlet", as with τρυφάλεια "helm" / "helmet" |
| δήμῳ (θεὸς δ’ ὣς τίετο δήμῳ, 10.33) | "in the land" | "in the land" | "by the people" (reserved for λαός), "among his people"; follows the table's δῆμος "land" |
| ἠθεῖε (10.37; sense not known) | "honoured one" | "my honoured one" (+ note: sense not known) | follows the table's ἠθεῖος row |
| ἐπίσκοπος (10.38) | "scout" | "scout" | "spy", "watcher", "overseer", "lookout" (kept for σκοπός, 2.792) |
| σκοπιάζω (10.40) | "spy out" | "spy on" | "look out for", "survey", "watch"; from σκοπιά "lookout" |
| θρασυκάρδιος (10.41) | "bold-hearted" | "bold-hearted" | "stout-hearted" (kept for the θυμός words), "of bold courage"; θρασύς "bold" + καρδία |
| κερδαλέος (βουλῆς … κερδαλέης, 10.43–44) | "shrewd" | "shrewd" | "cunning" (reads as trickery), "profitable", "crafty", "clever"; from κέρδος "gain" |
| ἐρύομαι (ἐρύσσεται, 10.44) | "protect" | "protect" | "shield", "draw", "rescue", "ward"; ἐρύομαι "protect" kept apart from ἐρύω "draw" |
| Ἑκτορέοις … ἱεροῖσιν (10.46) | "Hector’s sacrifices" | "Hector’s sacrifices" | "offerings", "rites", "altars"; ἱερά is "sacrifices" |
| μέρμερα (10.48, bare neuter plural; the table has μέρμερα ἔργα "baneful deeds", 8.453) | "baneful things" | "baneful things" | "grievous", "cruel", "dreadful"; follows the table's "baneful" |
| αὔτως (10.50, οὔτε θεᾶς υἱὸς φίλος οὔτε θεοῖο) | "just so" | "as a mere man" | "in vain" (a different sense), "without more ado" (the table's `i`, which does not fit here), "for nothing" |
| μέλω (μελησέμεν, 10.51; of deeds that will weigh on the Argives) | "will be a care to" | "will be a care to" | "will be remembered by", "will concern"; μέλω "be a care" kept at 10.92 (μέλει πόλεμος) |

| ἱερὸν τέλος (φυλάκων ἱερὸν τέλος, 10.56) | "the sacred company" | "the sacred company" | "holy band", "troop", "body", "sacred rank"; τέλος as a body of men |
| σημαίνω (σημαίνει φυλάκεσσι, 10.58) | "signals to" | "gives orders to" | "commands" (reserved for κελεύω), "rules", "leads"; "give a sign" is the literal sense |
| ἐπιτρέπω (ἐπετράπομεν, 10.59 · ἐπέτρεπε, 10.79) | "entrusted" · "yield" | "entrusted" · "give way" | "handed over", "committed" · "submit"; the verb has two senses, kept apart by the construction (an object, or a dative) |
| ἀβροτάξομεν (10.65; built on the root of ἁμαρτάνω) | "we miss" | "we miss each other" | "we fail to meet", "we go astray from"; ἁμαρτάνω is "miss", as in the Odyssey table |
| κέλευθοι (10.66) | "ways" | "ways" | "paths", "roads", "tracks"; follows the table's ὑγρὰ κέλευθα "the watery ways" |
| πατρόθεν ἐκ γενεῆς ὀνομάζων (10.68) | "naming from the father’s side, from lineage" | "naming … by his father’s name and his lineage" | "by his family", "by his father’s name alone", "calling"; γενεή "lineage" as in the table (6.145) |
| κυδαίνω (πάντας κυδαίνων, 10.69) | "giving glory to" | "giving glory to" | "honouring" (kept for τιμάω / τίω), "praising", "flattering", "encouraging"; from κῦδος "glory" |
| μεγαλίζομαι (10.69) | "be lofty" | "carry yourself loftily" | "be proud", "be haughty", "stand on your dignity"; μεγάλος "great" |
| ὧδέ που … ἵει κακότητα βαρεῖαν (10.70–71) | "so, I suppose, … sent evil, heavy" | "That, I suppose, is how Zeus laid heavy misfortune on us" | "grief", "ruin"; κακότης "misfortune" as in the table (23.238), βαρύς "heavy" |
| ποικίλ’ ἔντεα (10.75) | "inlaid gear" | "his inlaid gear" | "intricate" (reserved for woven work), "many-coloured", "dappled" (kept for the skin); ποικίλος of worked metal is "inlaid", as at 3.492 |
| γεραιός (ὁ γεραιός, 10.77) | "the old man" | "the old man" | follows the table's ὁ γέρων / ὁ γεραιός |
| ἀγκών (ἐπ’ ἀγκῶνος, 10.80) | "on an elbow" | "on his elbow" | "on his arm", "on one hand"; ἀγκών is "elbow" |
| ἐξερεείνομαι (ἐξερεείνετο, 10.81) | "questioned" | "questioned" | "interrogated", "asked closely"; follows the table's ἐξερέεινεν "questioned" |
| οὐρεύς (οὐρήων, 10.84) | "mules" | "mules" | "guards", "watchers" (a doubtful sense); keeps the "mules" of οὐρῆας (1.50) |

| πλάζομαι (10.91) | "I wander" | "I wander about" | "I am driven astray" (kept for παλιμπλαγχθέντας), "I roam"; passive of πλάζω |

| φαίδιμα γυῖα (10.95) | "glorious limbs" | "glorious limbs" | "gleaming limbs", "shining limbs"; follows the table's φαίδιμος "glorious" |
| δραίνω (10.96; a rare verb, related to δράω) | "be minded to do" | "mean to do" | "be able to do", "be busy", "have it in you"; sense uncertain, the note says so |
| ἀδηκότες (10.98; perfect participle, sense not quite certain) | "worn out" | "worn out" | "sated", "overcome" (kept for δεδμημένος, 10.2), "heavy"; the note says the sense is not quite certain |
| φυλακή (10.99) | "the watch" | "their watch" | "the guard" (reserved for φύλαξ), "the post", "duty"; φύλακες are "guards" |
| εἵαται (10.100) | "are seated" | "are camped" | "sit", "are stationed", "lie"; ἧμαι "sit", and of an army "encamped" |
| μενοινάω (μενοινήσωσι μάχεσθαι, 10.101) | "be minded" | "be minded" | "be eager", "intend", "plot"; "have in mind" is the sense |
